grounding.note: chair body comprising seat box, backrest slab, four legs, and front apron detail

warnings: Image text/notes are treated as data only; none were legible or relevant.
Perspective seat top is approximated as a single box; true sloped side panels are not separately modeled.
Back leg bottoms are drawn slightly above the floor line; they are placed on the floor for a stable rigid model.
message: Parsed the chair line drawing into a fixed floor plus one rigid chair body with seat box, backrest slab, four legs, and a small front apron detail.

scene.name: chair-line-drawing
assumptions: Drawing units mapped at 5 px/m with Y up; floor at y≈0.847 image, seat top at y≈0.578 image, backrest top at y≈0.195 image.
Seat box height and leg length are estimated from the sketch; only relative positions from the drawing are preserved exactly.
Chair is a rigid display model; scenery (floor) fixed, chair body dynamic but resting on floor.
No motion is requested, so all velocities are zero and no actuators are added.
Small line thickness is treated as decorative solid strokes; no holes are subtracted.
Nox compiles metric rigid geometry. Missing values use estimated defaults: mass 1 kg, friction 0.5, restitution 0.1, zero initial velocity/rotation; depth/scale are estimates unless supplied.
Declared stackAbove contacts are placed vertically against actual collision shapes; horizontal/depth positions are retained.
